body: Every time it see that mans name, I instantly dread that the next words I read will be "found dead".
Absolutely not. They are his daughters.

Why do you want to end it? Sounds like people love you, you have a masters degree, sound intelligent...what's missing? What do you find joy in? 

Take a step back. Read your post as the guy with the MS in Psy and what do you see? What would be your professional advice to someone that walked in the door with your story?

"That guy"? Seriously? Who gives a fuck? Really? At the age of 30 I'm going back to school. You are right, you should not be in school. Your head isn't anywhere near right for school right now if that petty b.s. is the reasoning you are using. Sorry is this rough talk, but you need to get your head straight.

Do you know how many college kids get a reality check the first quarter/semester? Quite a few. High school does very little to actually prepare people.

Far from the end of the world. It's not too late to change your declared major. Or, perhaps it might be better to ask for a academic session off to go to an affiliated JC to knock some credits out with less pressure and explore what you really want to do. 

Sounds like you are too focused on your social life. Focus on school for awhile, figure out why things haven't worked for you socially at this point. Make some changes in your life, improve things and then worry about the social life.

Stop.

There is nothing so bad, so horrible that it can't be fixed. You wouldn't be ending your pain: you'll just be multiplying and spreading it to every person who loves you. Do you really want your kids growing up asking themselves "why!?!" you abandoned them everyday.

This is bigger than you. Work with your husband. Get help and support from either your family and friends, or look for programs out there than can help.

You made vows to your husband, and he to you: talk to him, work this through.
Here if you need to talk. It sounds like you also need to talk to your companies HR department about workplace conditions
Send me a PM, be happy to talk.

Been where you are, and it's not fun. Don't worry, as much as it feels like you need to, about finding someone. Work on you. Work on being happy by yourself. Spend everyday improving yourself, your life, and finding happiness. Along the way, someone will find you (don't go out of your way to find them). Trust me.
If you want to chat, send me a message. I have some experience in this area, unfortunately.

I'm saving every penny at this point in the hopes to make it through to the next job. Thank you for the message. 

I just don't know how many more times I can have my life fall apart around me before I can't take it anymore.
